findings.question: Are all six workflow bindings valid?
findings.evidence: bmad doctor: 6 valid bindings; definitions re-derived from the pinned 6.12.4 release; shims refused

findings.question: Can each workflow be prepared with correct inputs?
findings.evidence: packet preparation requires eligibility (G2 for the exact scope, workflow state, upstream receipts); every workflow is refused for programs:PORTREAD (workflow-binding-validation.json); MOCK preparation is tested on synthetic scopes (tests/step6-9)

findings.question: Does every workflow run under the required authorization and isolation boundary?
findings.evidence: executeLive requires a recorded preflight that permits the launch; the new sandbox runner re-checks the preflight, the recorded disclosure authorization and every source/input hash and runs only inside sandbox.sh (network none)

findings.question: Are BMad outputs consumed by the next F1-F7 stage?
findings.evidence: before: only later BMad bindings read earlier receipts; F1-F7 dispatch packets never included BMad output. Now verified LIVE BMad documents are optional, non-authoritative inputs of F3 (PRD), F4 (PRD, architecture), F5 (stories, sprint) and F7 (build); F1, F2 and F6 never receive them. No real receipt exists, so no packet has received one

findings.question: Does the workflow stop when a required stage fails?
findings.evidence: governedRun stops at the first BLOCKED / EXECUTION_FAILED / EXECUTED_REJECTED stage; later stages NOT_ATTEMPTED (tests/bmad-e2e, step21)

findings.question: Are actual LIVE receipts validated?
findings.evidence: recordResult re-evaluates the LIVE gate from preflight facts; governance.receiptCounts requires accepted, sealed, intact, current-digest LIVE receipts with unchanged documents

findings.question: Can local-generation output be marked BMad-compliant?
findings.evidence: compliance is computed from BMad receipts only; LGA conversions print LOCAL_LGA_NOT_BMAD_GOVERNED; historical records are not relabelled

findings.question: Can any command bypass mandatory governance?
findings.evidence: before: `pilot authorize` could create a NEW local-generation authorisation without BMad evidence; now refused BMAD_BLOCKED without verified receipts up to sprint and accepted F2. Re-conversion under the existing LGA records (convert-app / generate) stays permitted as historical, non-BMad work until those records expire on 2026-12-03; workflow generation needs BMad evidence (generationAuthorized); top-level `generate` refuses

findings.question: Are all source, authorization and engineering gates preserved?
findings.evidence: no gate, check or expected test result was changed; regression-results.json

findings.question: What still prevents end-to-end execution?
findings.evidence: trust store, signed disclosure authorization, PORTREAD G2 (12 findings), workflow state, live_execution.requested, runner and egress inside the boundary, F6 receipt for PORTREAD, generation authority for Build (blockers.json)
